name: Mario
source: The leader of seven food sprites from Italy, who traveled to Japan based on rumors of a 5-star restaurant and eventually settled at Dogen Hut, helping the widowed [url=/c93382]Maki Yoneda[/url] cook. He specializes in meat dishes.
